# CodeBlock

Multi-line code in a framed block: header with title and/or language, copy button, mono 13/20 text on bg-subtle.

`KenosUI.CodeBlock` · Typography

## Use

```jsx
<KenosUI.CodeBlock>…</KenosUI.CodeBlock>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="KenosUI.CodeBlock">…</x-import>
```

## Notes

Code with header (title / language) and copy button. Markdown ``` fences render as this.

## Props (CodeBlockProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `code` | `string` | The code as text (preferred: the copy button copies exactly this). |
| `language` | `string` | Shown in the header, e.g. "yaml", "bash". Also sets `language-*` on <code> for a highlighter. |
| `title` | `React.ReactNode` |  |
| `copyable` | `boolean` | Default true. |
| `variant` | `"default" \| "terminal"` | "terminal" = always dark (black), for command output. |
| `maxHeight` | `number \| string` | Scroll after this height. |
| `actions` | `React.ReactNode` | Extra header buttons. |
| `highlight` | `boolean` | Built-in highlighting for yaml, json, bash/sh, ini/toml/env, js/ts, python, dockerfile, nix, log, diff, sql. Default true. |
| `lineNumbers` | `boolean` |  |
| `highlightLines` | `number[]` | 1-based line numbers to mark. |
| `wrap` | `boolean` | Soft-wrap long lines instead of scrolling. |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` |  |

_Also accepts: Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, "title">._
